name: Abinadab
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy

points: The ark had been taken from Israel by the Philistines in the days of the judges because of sin, and it had been left in the house of Abinadab. Through the wilderness there had been no house for the Lord, so the ark was moved from place to place.

note.label: 2 Samuel 6: David Brings Up the Ark of God

points: They brought up the ark of the Most High, who dwelleth between the cherubims, carrying it in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab.
